title: Інверсія для наголосу
explanation:
Після **заперечних і обмежувальних** слів на початку речення порядок слів — **як у питанні**: *Never **have I** seen such a mess.*

Типові вирази: **Never / Rarely / Seldom**, **Not only … but also**, **No sooner … than**, **Hardly … when**, **Under no circumstances**, **Only then / Only after**, **Not until**, **Little** (did I know).

Це книжний, емоційний або офіційний стиль. У звичайній розмові: *I've never seen…*
formula: Never / Rarely / Not only … + **допоміжне + підмет** + V

head: Вираз
Приклад
Звичайний порядок
rows: Never have I felt so tired.
I have never felt so tired.
Not only did he lie, but he also blamed me.
No sooner had we arrived than it started to rain.
Under no circumstances should you open it.
You mustn't open it under any circumstances.

examples.en: Rarely do we get such good weather in November.
examples.uk: У листопаді рідко буває така гарна погода.

examples.en: Little did I know what was waiting for me.
examples.uk: Я й гадки не мав, що на мене чекає.

examples.en: Only then did I realise my mistake.
examples.uk: Лише тоді я зрозумів свою помилку.

examples.en: Not until I moved abroad did I understand my parents.
examples.uk: Лише переїхавши за кордон, я зрозумів батьків.

examples.en: Hardly had I sat down when the phone rang.
examples.uk: Ледве я сів, як задзвонив телефон.

tip: Якщо в реченні немає допоміжного дієслова, додаємо **do / does / did**: *Never **did** she complain.*

exercises.prompt: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents.
No sooner had we left ___ it started snowing.
Under no circumstances ___ the door to strangers.
Little ___ (I / know) that he was lying. (3 слова)
Hardly ___ (we / start) when the power went out.

exercises.sentence: Only later I read the whole letter.
exercises.explanation: Інверсія після Only later: Only later did I read the whole letter.

exercises.sentence: Seldom we eat out these days.
exercises.explanation: Інверсія після Seldom: Seldom do we eat out these days.

exercises.prompt: I have never tasted such good pizza.
answer: Never have I tasted such good pizza.

exercises.prompt: He didn't apologise, and he also blamed me.
answer: Not only did he not apologise, but he also blamed me.
Not only didn't he apologise, but he also blamed me.
Not only did he fail to apologise, but he also blamed me.
Not only did he not apologise, he also blamed me.
Not only did he not apologize, but he also blamed me.

exercises.uk: Лише тоді я зрозумів, наскільки це важливо.
answer: Only then did I understand how important it was.
Only then did I realise how important it was.
Only then did I realize how important it was.
Only then did I understand how important it is.
